name: The James River Association
description: The James River Association is dedicated to being a guardian of the James River, providing a voice for the river, and taking action to promote conservation and responsible stewardship of its natural resources

name: Undoing Ruin
notes_internal: Learning about quick plant swaps for when people are looking to go nuts at Lowes Garden Center is something accessible.

name: Moulton Hot Natives
description: Moulton Hot Natives' goal is to make native plants that are sustainably sourced from wild populations in the Richmond area more commercially available and to spread awareness that native plants are not just beautiful and low maintenance, they are the backbone that all living things depend upon.
notes_internal: Local to Northside; grower sources local ecotype seeds and grows them from a home nursery. Avoid publishing the grower's home-based location.

name: Ecosia
description: Ecosia is a not-for-profit company that plants and protects trees. We dedicate 100% of our profits to the planet and create simple ways for people to be climate active every day. Collaborating with local communities, we have planted more than 200 million trees (and counting) all over the world
notes_internal: Internal tag: "AI solution that uses renewable energy" -- imprecise (it's a search engine, not an AI product); don't surface this framing publicly.

name: Shalom Farms
description: Shalom Farms is a nonprofit farm and food justice organization working for an equitable food system in Richmond, VA. With two production farms, dozens of partners, and innovative food access programs, Shalom Farms grows and distributes over 600,000 servings of Certified Naturally Grown produce every year.

name: Purring Hearts VA
description: Purring Hearts VA is a foster-based cat rescue proudly rooted in the Richmond community. As the rescue division of Lionhearts, Inc., we are 100% volunteer-run and powered by the generosity of donors and foster families who open their hearts and homes to cats in need.
notes_public: They accept donations of clean, empty pill bottles for reuse in their foster program.
notes_internal: We were told they're pretty much always looking for more; consider setting up a collection bin in the office.

name: Adopt-a-Highway (VDOT)
description: Virginia's Adopt-a-Highway program enlists the support of over 20,000 residents in removing litter from Commonwealth roadsides. Running since the 1980s, this program is a key strategy in maintaining a positive travel experience for residents and visitors, and in preventing litter from entering local waterways.
notes_internal: In case we're interested in potentially adopting a nearby road for litter clean-up.

name: Too Good to Go
description: Too Good To Go is a social impact company on a mission to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.

name: FarmBus
description: Farm to Family is a year-round CSA and local farmer's market serving Richmond, VA and Washington, DC.

name: Climate Fresk
description: An organization that is delivering sustainability trainings.
notes_internal: Partnership in place with other entities.

name: Acorn Host
description: IT hosting company using carbon-neutral servers -- Friendly Green Web Hosting from Portland, Oregon.

name: Viridiant
description: Local energy efficiency consultancy; offers trainings.

name: Rag & Bones Bicycle Cooperative
description: Volunteer-run bicycle co-operative located in Northside in Richmond, Virginia. A D.I.Y. space, not a traditional bike shop -- provides the tools and knowledge needed to complete your own bike repair.

name: SCRAP RVA (Richmond Creative Reuse Center)
description: A 501(c)(3) nonprofit whose mission is to inspire creative reuse and environmentally sustainable behavior by providing educational programs and affordable materials to the community. A donation-based creative reuse store and donation center in Richmond, VA.
